title: Lightee Electron Wiring
subtitle: Frontend → preload → main → engine/filesystem
purpose: This map is the source of truth for the desktop application's cross-layer connections and the completed Ticket 20 → Ticket 21 / FLOW-01 release gates.

nodes.label: Renderer shell + prototype UI
nodes.interface: Mounts the default design-shell workbench and the isolated verification routes.

nodes.label: Typed IPC client
nodes.interface: Typed invoke/event result mapping and the review-rule adapter; no Node or arbitrary channel access.

nodes.label: CodeMirror 6 paragraph editor
nodes.interface: Paragraph-backed continuous text, structural transaction annotations, independent source/translation history, Kitty cursor overlay, and shared-paragraph focus decorations.

nodes.label: Whitelist bridge
nodes.interface: Exposes invoke, named event subscriptions, ping, and flushPendingWrites only.

nodes.label: Electron IPC router
nodes.interface: Owns ipcMain handlers, broadcasts serializable events, drains writes before window destruction.

nodes.label: Versioned IPC contract + validator
nodes.interface: Versioned envelope, command/request/response maps, event map, runtime payload validation.

nodes.label: IpcService application adapter
nodes.interface: Workspace/session registry, revision checks, draft/source/term/settings/review-rule persistence, event emission.

nodes.label: Atomic file adapter
nodes.interface: Per-file mutation queue plus tmp-write/fsync/rename replacement.

nodes.label: Translation/review/import engine
nodes.interface: Main-owned adapters call engine import, translate, review, confirm and export operations; automated runs inject fake LLMs.

nodes.label: Workspace files + revisions
nodes.interface: Main-owned writes for drafts, translations, source corrections, terms, settings, checkpoints and review rules.

nodes.label: Editor persistence/autosave
nodes.interface: Autosave, checkpoints and source corrections use current workspace/chapter context with revision protection.

edges.label: UI commands and save-state mapping
edges.detail: The default workbench routes commands through the typed client and current workspace/chapter context.

edges.label: Paragraph changes → saveDraft
edges.detail: CodeMirror transactions feed context-bound autosave and revision-protected chapter persistence.

edges.label: window.lightee.invoke / onEvent
edges.detail: The renderer receives a small typed surface; ipcRenderer is never exposed.

edges.label: lightee:invoke / lightee:event / lightee:flush
edges.detail: Main validates every envelope and serializes all event payloads, including reviewRules.changed.

edges.label: validateEnvelope + typed maps
edges.detail: Version 1 envelope and command allowlist are shared by main and renderer typecheck.

edges.label: IpcService.invoke
edges.detail: Service returns IpcResult and emits chapter/workspace/terms plus canonical terminology.changed events.

edges.label: queued atomic JSON writes
edges.detail: Drafts, settings, terms, source corrections, checkpoints and review rules use main-owned writes.

edges.label: tmp + fsync + rename
edges.detail: Revision metadata prevents stale saves from overwriting newer disk state.

edges.label: translate/review/import commands
edges.detail: IPC service invokes the engine adapters, injects persisted review rules into custom-rule checks, emits progress, persists staging/reports, and promotes only approved output.

edges.label: autosave/checkpoint lifecycle
edges.detail: The editor invokes saveDraft/checkpoint and source-correction persistence before chapter switching or window flush.

channels.name: lightee:invoke
channels.notes: Command allowlist and runtime validation execute in main.

channels.name: lightee:event
channels.notes: Only named events in IPC_EVENT_NAMES are forwarded.

channels.name: lightee:flush
channels.notes: Used before Electron window destruction; timeout is handled by main.

commands.name: translate.run
commands.writes: state/chapter_state.json + state/events.jsonl + staging/promotion journal + approved translation
commands.notes: FLOW-01 makes the shared Orchestrator/state machine authoritative; chapter.load reads the complete locked snapshot, approved export is durable-state gated, and automated tests inject a fake llm.

commands.name: review.run
commands.reads: current approved/staging chapter content and review rules
commands.writes: review report history only; no chapter workflow transition
commands.notes: Report-only review remains separate from translate.run and does not promote staging or change chapter state.

commands.name: confirm.list/decide
commands.writes: state/cards.json + confirm-session.json + canonical terminology snapshot + legacy projections
commands.notes: Confirmation commits are idempotent repository operations with a workspace-wide revision; legacy archive files are compatibility projections.

commands.name: terms.query/update/delete/restore
commands.reads: state/terminology-snapshot.json (legacy archive files are migration/projection inputs only)
commands.writes: terms.* -> canonical snapshot + legacy projections + state/term-trash + terminology-wide revision
commands.notes: terms.query returns one snapshot-consistent deterministic page with archive-qualified rows; pages after the first require baseRevision and conflict on snapshot changes. terms.update/delete/restore remain terms.json-only and require the canonical baseRevision.

commands.name: reviewRules.read/add/update/delete
commands.notes: Default route loads the current workspace snapshot; mutations require baseRevision and use atomic writes.

tickets.title: CodeMirror 6 + CJK IME prototype
tickets.caveat: Synthetic Chrome CDP composition passed for Chinese/Japanese commit/cancel. OS-level Windows IME popup was not invoked.

tickets.title: Export/settings GUI
tickets.caveat: Settings and export IPC paths are wired; the default workbench uses the current workspace/chapter target. EPUB export remains outside the desktop TXT release gate.

tickets.title: Kitty cursor trail
tickets.caveat: Synthetic Chrome CDP composition passed; OS-level Windows IME popup was not invoked.

tickets.title: Continuous editor UI
tickets.caveat: The isolated route remains a prototype validation surface; the default workbench uses the context-bound editor and persistence path.

tickets.title: Focus/alignment
tickets.caveat: Focus preference persistence is deferred to settings/autosave tickets.

tickets.title: Shortcuts panel
tickets.caveat: Find/replace actions open the discovery panel as a placeholder; real search UI is deferred with the real export/settings work.

tickets.title: Autosave/settings
tickets.caveat: Context-bound draft, checkpoint and source-correction persistence are covered by Ticket 19; isolated settings preference coverage remains unit-test scoped.

tickets.title: Responsive/transitions
tickets.caveat: View transition timing verified by CDP class/timing assertions; pixel-level motion rendering not diffed.

tickets.title: Review/editor bridge
tickets.caveat: The isolated route keeps synthetic review fixtures for editor interaction coverage; the default workbench receives real review output through Ticket 20.

tickets.title: Context terms panel
tickets.caveat: The isolated route keeps seeded terms for interaction coverage; the default workbench hydrates per-workspace terms and confirmation state through Ticket 20.

tickets.title: Workspace management GUI
tickets.caveat: The isolated route remains for workspace interaction coverage; the default workbench uses the real tree and session path from Tickets 17/18.

tickets.title: Term confirmation GUI
tickets.caveat: The isolated route keeps seeded cards for interaction coverage; the default workbench hydrates and decides the real confirmation session through Ticket 20.

tickets.title: Real engine wiring
tickets.caveat: import/export/confirm/review run against the real engine in tests and Electron smoke; translate.run is wired with a real LLM runtime (reads ~/.pi/agent/models.json) but automated runs inject a fake llm — a real paid call requires explicit user confirmation.

tickets.title: Desktop workbench context merge
tickets.caveat: Default no-query product entry is the design-shell desktop workbench; variant and isolated prototype routes are supplementary verification only.

tickets.title: Real workspace tree and session persistence
tickets.caveat: User-level registry is stored under Electron userData; workspace session and metadata remain inside each workspace.

tickets.title: Real chapter loading and editor persistence
tickets.caveat: Real chapter hydration, draft/source-correction persistence, revision conflicts and protected desktop chapter switching are covered. Ticket 20 only closes the remaining review result UI and human decision path.

tickets.title: Real review, terms, confirmation, and actions
tickets.caveat: Default-route workflow status, approved-only reveal/export, stuck human decision, and immutable review-history summaries are covered; automated tests inject a fake LLM.

tickets.title: Desktop vertical slice verification gate
tickets.caveat: Production Electron TXT + Markdown release gate passed with restart/reopen, approved/stuck workflow paths, zero runtime exceptions, and zero console errors; mobile polish, real LLM calls and deep EPUB checks stay out of scope.

tickets.title: Real light-novel EPUB fixture
tickets.caveat: Real Chinese collection and Japanese single-volume EPUB are external fixtures; both core parsing and engine workspace-import tests pass. Translation quality stays in the TXT gate; deeper cross-language/layout checks are optional follow-up.

tickets.title: Default visible entry bridge
tickets.caveat: Welcome actions call the real workspace handle and never replace the workbench with legacy enterWorkbench/show behavior.

tickets.title: Real start without demo data
tickets.caveat: The existing workspace card is reused; invalid recent/session rows and static demo identifiers are hidden or removed on the default route.

tickets.title: Persisted review-rule management
tickets.caveat: Default route reads and mutates the current workspace review-rules.json through revision-protected IPC; variant routes may retain in-memory seed rules.

tickets.title: Default workbench user acceptance
tickets.caveat: Automated release coverage is expanded; direct human acceptance of the real workbench remains a separate user decision.

tickets.title: Resizable shell, settings collapse, and Chinese title
tickets.caveat: Desktop visual harness covered 1280x800, 1024x700 and 820x620; temporary screenshots were removed after inspection.

tickets.title: Workspace create field validation
tickets.caveat: Empty name and empty path are rejected in the current dialog before IPC; valid creation remains covered by the production release gate.

tickets.title: Empty workspace open state
tickets.caveat: Empty workspaces stay visible as opened workspace state and show waiting-for-import status; chapter-bearing workspaces still enter the editor.

tickets.title: Terminology revision and event authority
tickets.caveat: Canonical terminology snapshot, workspace lock/queue, idempotent commits, revision-token pagination, external event polling, renderer convergence, malformed projection recovery, and multi-archive restart coverage are complete. Root QA-01 workspace scope and intermittent Electron sandbox startup diagnostics remain separate follow-up items.

tickets.title: Canonical persisted chapter pipeline
tickets.caveat: Electron translate.run delegates to the shared Orchestrator, chapter snapshots/events are durable, promotion recovery is journaled under a dedicated chapter lock, renderer state is snapshot/event driven, and fake-LLM approved/stuck/restart release gates pass. FLOW-02/03/04 and QA-01 remain subsequent work.
